scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run materialize:route-shells && npm run check:release-artifacts
scripts.build:production: node scripts/assert-production-env.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && npm run materialize:route-shells && npm run check:release-artifacts
scripts.build:demo: tsc -b && VITE_DEMO_MODE=true vite build && npm run materialize:route-shells && npm run check:release-artifacts
scripts.check:release-artifacts: node scripts/check-building-models.mjs && node scripts/check-building-room-views.mjs && node scripts/check-electrical-plan.mjs && node scripts/check-release-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/check-seo-artifacts.mjs
scripts.check:live-release: node scripts/check-live-release.mjs && node scripts/check-seo-http.mjs && node scripts/check-live-building-models.mjs && node scripts/check-live-electrical-plan.mjs && node scripts/check-building-room-views.mjs --live
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:demo && VITE_DEMO_MODE=true playwright test
scripts.build:courses:member: tsc -p tsconfig.courses.json && vite build --config vite.courses.config.ts --mode member
scripts.build:courses:production: tsc -p tsconfig.courses.json && vite build --config vite.courses.config.ts --mode courses-production && node scripts/courses/check-release.mjs
